description: A muscular lizard man sits cross-legged on the ground, shown from the knees up, facing the viewer at eye level. His scales are bright green with darker green and grey shading across shoulders and chest; his long-snouted reptile head is turned to the viewer's right, a small red eye on its side. He wears only a pale green loincloth held by a belt with a square gold buckle. One hand rests on his knee while the other is raised beside his head, palm out in greeting. He sits on speckled orange-brown earth against plain black, calm and peaceful. Frame 1: the head is in profile facing right, hand raised. Frame 2: the head turns slightly toward the viewer and the hand sways. Frame 3: the head faces the viewer directly, held as long as frame 1. Frame 4: the head swings back toward the right, brief. Frame 5: the head is in profile with the snout tipped up, brief. The loop reads as a friendly wave while he turns to look at the party and away again.
title: Lizard man sitting and waving
